title: NTT Smile Energy: no personal data leak confirmed so far, per its 13 November notice
what_changed: The summary said customer names, contact details and login credentials may have leaked. NTT Smile Energy's own third report (13 November, nttse.com) says no trace of personal data leaking outside has been confirmed so far and that solar generation and power sales were unaffected; its second report (6 November) says points will be compensated in full. Summary, plain, exec and action updated; the company's notices added as primary sources; validation moved to corroborated.
